status_note: The freshness limits were frozen on 2026-10-31 on the owner's instruction, as proposed (ledgers/approvals.jsonl). The other D1 thresholds are frozen at the values in config/phases.json by status events before phase D1 is marked ready. PX4 parameters and failsafe cases are proposals for D1 to test. Every number is estimated; none is measured.

justification.max_setpoint_age_ns: A 20 Hz command stream may miss three setpoints. At 1.0 m/s this is 0.2 m of travel, and 0.5 m at the 2.5 m/s GPS limit, counted in the reaction term in docs/OPERATING_ENVELOPE.md.
justification.max_sensor_age_ns: Over four frames at 30 Hz, the minimum rate Isaac ROS Visual SLAM states. Counted in the same reaction term.
justification.max_estimator_age_ns: PX4 recommends external vision at 30 to 50 Hz [D43]; 100 ms allows about two missed updates at 30 Hz or four at 50 Hz. To be replaced with measurements.

sim_limits.note: The GPS limits in docs/OPERATING_ENVELOPE.md, used so the arithmetic's worst case is exercised. Enforced by the command gate on setpoints and by MPC_XY_VEL_MAX. D1 confirms Position mode obeys it.

ET-D1-1.threshold: 2/2 clean launches report identical versions; zero null pins

ET-D1-2.threshold: 10/10 nominal runs reach every waypoint within 0.5 m, checked by independent code from logged state

ET-D1-4.threshold: every listed fault case executed and logged; any deviation from specification reported; configured and tested behaviour recorded separately

ET-D1-5.threshold: freshness gate tests green with the bounds above; heartbeat continuity never counts as setpoint freshness
